title: A Survey of Race, Racism, and Anti-Racism in NLP

bias_targets.methodology: A comprehensive literature review and survey of 79 papers from the ACL Anthology to evaluate how racial bias is measured, mitigated, and operationalized across various NLP tasks (e.g., analyzing the use of U.S. census-aligned categories, African American English (AAE) linguistic markers, dialect classification, name lists, and explicit identity keywords).

Reviewing a small subset of NLP literature that examines the intersection of multiple identity axes (e.g., race and gender, such as the experiences of Black women) using word embeddings, co-occurrences, and representational similarity analysis.
